task: binary classification of protein sequences as allergen (positive) vs non-allergen; P(allergen) in [0, 1], the mean of three member probabilities, called allergen at >= 0.5
architecture: equal-weight mean of three probabilities: RBF SVC (StandardScaler -> SVC, C=1, gamma=0.0005; sigmoid of the margin), LDA (StandardScaler -> LinearDiscriminantAnalysis; posterior) and an MLP (640-480-240-64-1, BatchNorm + GELU, dropout 0.5; sigmoid of the logit). The notebook's random forest is not part of the ensemble
esm_embedding: mean-pooled last_hidden_state over residue positions, BOS/EOS excluded
weights_layout: SVM.joblib, LDA.joblib (sklearn pipelines), MLP.pt (joblib dict: state, scaler, d_in)

training_data.note: full-length proteins; no sequence is shorter than 50 residues

validation_metrics.source: Models/Allergenicity/training.ipynb, threshold at each member's own class boundary
validation_metrics.caveat: the ensemble rule is not in the notebook; it was chosen here by validation AUC and does not beat SVM alone on MCC (0.801)
